== Description ==

[[Jordan Gosiaco]] (background mid table, curly dark hair, green/white/grey WILSON colorblock hoodie, playing), [[Greg Shaw]], [[Brian Fred]], and [[Logan Pietig]] at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
